name: Tabs
intent: A row of tabs that switches between related views in the same place. The selected tab has a brand label and underline.
usage: Use Tabs to switch between two or more related views on one page, like the sections of a record or settings. One component: pass items with a label and, optionally, an icon, a count and content. With content, Tabs shows the selected panel under the strip; without it, it is a strip only and you show the view yourself from value and onChange. size sets the height (sm is the default); expand stretches the tabs across the row; border draws the line under the strip. For a small always-visible choice like density or a view switch, use Segmented. See contracts/tabs.json for the full contract.

items.itemShape: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; count?: number; countLabel?: string; disabled?: boolean; content?: ReactNode }
items.note: Two or more. icon is a leading Material Symbols name. count shows a kit Count after the label; countLabel says what it counts for screen readers. content is the panel for that tab.

label.note: Names the tab list for screen readers, like Invoice sections.

defaultValue.note: Uncontrolled start id. Defaults to the first enabled tab.

onChange.note: (id: string) => void. Runs on click and on arrow keys.

size.note: Tab height 32 / 40 / 48 px, label 12 / 14 / 16 px. sm is the default.

expand.note: Tabs share the full width equally instead of hugging their labels.

border.note: The 1px line under the whole strip.

useWhen: Sections of one record or page, like Overview / Invoices / Payments.
Two to seven peer views that share the same context.
doNot: Do not invent TabList, Tab, TabPanel, TabsTrigger or a local tab strip. It is one component.
Do not use for app or page navigation. Use the side nav.
Do not use for a small choice that applies at once, like density or List / Board. Use Segmented.
Do not select more than one tab, and do not disable a tab to hide it. Leave it out instead.
a11y: A tablist named by label; each tab is a button with role tab and aria-selected. With content, the panel is a tabpanel named by its tab.
One tab stop. Arrow Left and Right move and select, Home and End jump to the ends. Disabled tabs are skipped.
The selected tab is shown by an underline as well as color. Focus shows the kit ring inside the tab.
A count is read with its countLabel, like 5 unpaid invoices.
snippet:
<Tabs
  label="Account sections"
  items={[
    { id: "overview", label: "Overview" },
    { id: "invoices", label: "Invoices", count: 5 },
    { id: "payments", label: "Payments" },
  ]}
/>
